turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
ng time depends on the destination, and orders generally ship within 2 business days after being placed.

For the continental US, standard shipping is typically:
• East Coast: 1 to 3 business days after shipment, or about 3 to 5 business days from the order date
• West Coast: 3 to 5 business days after shipment, or about 5 to 7 business days from the order date

FedEx Ground delivers Monday through Friday. During November and December, delivery can take an extra 2 to 3 business days 🙂
